title: Total influence error bounds
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$, let $E_m$ be the total influence of majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$ minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$. Then $0\le E_m\le \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2m+1}}$.
